criteria.text: DECIDING, ORACLE-WATERFALL (the 95% INTERVAL decides): rho = (R_AF - B) / (O_adj - B); REALISATION-GAP iff UB95(rho) < 0.25; NOT-SHOWN otherwise; NOT EVALUABLE if O_adj <= B. SCOREABLE (SE 0.0363 from UNION-AF-ROUTE's realised two-stage interval, MDE80 0.102, predicted 0.08)

criteria.denominator: 5,907 EVAL items / 5,404 components; two-stage bootstrap B 2,000

criteria.text: SCORED (the 95% INTERVAL decides): lambda = (O_q - O_adj) / (O_q - B); LUCK-MATERIAL iff LB95 > 0.10; NOT-SHOWN otherwise. SCOREABLE (SE 0.0143, MDE80 0.040; O_adj model-based, independence disclosed)

criteria.denominator: 250 partition pairs (10 UMAP pairs, about 5 independent)

plain_description.what: Builds a waterfall from the per-question best-of-18 oracle, corrected for lucky guesses, down through a per-cell oracle and the trained router to the best single model, and tests whether regions of a 2-D map of the questions stay the same when the random seeds change. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Shows how much of the apparent routing headroom is reachable and whether the map's regions can be described at all.
plain_description.information: Would size the gap between oracle and realised routing gain. Result: registered, not run yet.
